task.description:
Produce a design artefact for SPC-01 and SPC-02 (WF-02 Batch B).

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-b-20260815

REQUIREMENTS:
- SPC-01 (SHOULD, Stage 15, VALIDATED): Declared input/output contract for SUB_PROCESS nodes
- SPC-02 (SHOULD, Stage 15, VALIDATED): Contract validated at definition-time

CONTEXT:
- Both requirements extend EXT-05 (full parent-variable-map copy semantics) and reference EE-09/EE-10 (variable merge / error state), PD-02/PD-05 (definition validation).
- PLC-01..04 were released in Batch A (PR #787) — process module catalog. SPC-01/02 are the SUB_PROCESS interface contract layer that the catalog's interface_schema may consume (see PLC-01 AC).
- The design should cover BOTH backend (Zig runtime semantics for SUB_PROCESS activation + definition-time validation) and, if applicable, any frontend schema-editing surface for the interface object.
- Write the design artefact to src/design/ following the repo's existing naming convention (e.g. src/design/spc-01-sub-process-interface-contract.md).

DELIVERABLES:
- Interfaces/types for the `interface` object on SUB_PROCESS nodes (inputs/outputs: {name, json_schema, required})
- Runtime semantics: filtered variable copy into child (SPC-01), filtered merge back on child completion (SPC-01), EE-10 error transitions for missing/invalid inputs and missing required outputs
- Definition-time validation (SPC-02): json_schema well-formedness check -> HTTP 422
- Data-flow diagram (text/ASCII) for SUB_PROCESS activation with a declared interface
- Cross-reference to PLC-01 interface_schema and how the two fit together
